'''Samara Organa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to [[House Panteer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], Samara was determined to discern the truth about the assassination of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Gaul Panteer]] and uncover his murderer after the end of the [[Great Galactic War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], she was allied with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orrick Gwyndon]] of the Panteer [[Queensguard]], where they tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ally with recovering the assassination holorecording from the library in the Holo Archives of [[Castle Panteer]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Samara appears in the mission "Red Handed" for Republic-allied players in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the mission starting point and endpoint. She is also a flirting option for male players of Republic classes.<ref name="TOR" />
